title: Decant report, schemaVersion 1
description: A shape-only report about one cleaned link. It carries no link, no parameter values and no path. The relay rejects anything that does not match, extra fields included. A later schemaVersion may add fields; v1 never will.

reportId.description: Random UUID v4 (lowercase), made fresh for each report and never reused across reports. A retried send repeats the same ID and is stored once. The relay keeps it only as long as the raw report.

kind.description: tracker-kept: a tracking parameter was not removed. link-broke: the cleaned link stopped working.

host.description: Lowercase host name of the link. No scheme, port, path, user info or IP address (the last label must start with a letter).

appMajor.description: Major version of the app that sent the report.

date.description: Calendar day of the report (YYYY-MM-DD), rounded to the day by the sender. Checked for shape only; the relay stores its own receive day.

removed.description: Parameters the app removed from the link.

kept.description: Parameters the app kept in the link.

note.description: Optional free text typed by the user, sent exactly as typed. 1 to 280 characters (Unicode code points), no control characters except tab and newline, and no line or paragraph separators, bidirectional overrides or unpaired surrogates.

name.description: Parameter name. Limited character set: no '=', '/', '@', '%' or spaces, so a value or path cannot be written into it.

shape.description: What the value looked like, never the value. charset is the narrowest class that holds every character, in this order: empty, digits, hex (a-f and 0-9, lowercase), alpha (a-z, A-Z), alnum (a-z, A-Z, 0-9), base64url (alnum plus '-' and '_'), other. empty and length 0 go together.
